Meaning: v. to decrease the size or amount of something
Example: You can reduce waste when you recycle.

Meaning: v. to use again or use more than once
Example: The old boxes can be reused to organize our toys.

Meaning: v. to recover things that have already been used so that they can be used again
Example: The company recycles about 85% of the paper it uses.

Meaning: n. the protection of the natural environment
Example: We know how important the conservation of wildlife is.

Meaning: adj. that can continue or be continued for a long time
Example: Unfortunately, this level of output is not sustainable.

Meaning: adj. aware of something
Example: Mario is conscious of how many chocolates he eats in a day.

Meaning: v. to express something without stating it directly
Example: By pausing the story and looking up at us, our teacher was implying that we should stop talking.

Meaning: v. to say or do the opposite of something
Example: If we contradict each other's opinions too often then we might end up fighting.

Meaning: n. the powerful effect that something has on someone or something
Example: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.

Meaning: prep. in place of someone or something
Example: I had an apple instead of a banana for a snack.

Meaning: n. an early version of something that is not yet in its final form
Example: This is only the first draft of my speech.

Meaning: adj. less important or serious than others of the same kind
Example: The minor problem with the computer was quickly fixed by restarting it.

Meaning: v. to produce goods in large numbers, usually in a factory using machines
Example: He works for a company that manufactures car parts.

Meaning: v. to copy or imitate
Example: The chameleon mimics the colors of its surroundings to hide.

Meaning: n. a set of attitudes or fixed ideas that someone has and that are often difficult to change
Example: You need a positive mindset to overcome these obstacles.

Meaning: adj. easily seen or understood
Example: The big footprint in the sand was an obvious sign that someone had been there.

Meaning: v. to fall or flow downward in a way similar to a waterfall
Example: Her hair was cascading over her shoulders as she brushed it.

Meaning: v. to knock your foot against something and fall or nearly fall
Example: She tripped and fell last night and broke her hip.

Meaning: v. to give money or goods to help a person or organization
Example: He frequently donates large sums to charity.

Meaning: adj. worn out or used up
Example: The artist could not finish her painting with her depleted set of paints.

Meaning: v. To give up a high office.
Example: When Edward VIII abdicated the throne in 1936, his younger brother became king of England.

Meaning:
v. 1. To take for granted; to suppose.
2. To take over; to occupy.
3. To pretend to have.
Example:
1. We cannot assume that Mom and Dad will meet us at the station if the train is two hours late.
2. Ruth Bader Ginsberg assumed office as a justice of the Supreme Court in 1993.
3. Edin assumed a look of innocence when Vilma asked who had eaten the rest of the salad.

Meaning: v. To do something badly or without skill.
Example: Because the shortstop bungled the double play, the runner made it safely to first base.

Meaning:
v. 1. To rule or control; to have a very important place or position.
2. To rise high above.
Example:
1. Rock dominated popular music in America for several decades.
2. The Willis Tower dominates the Chicago skyline.

Meaning:
adj. Coming before in time; having been at an earlier time.
n. The first of two just mentioned.
Example:
adj. Three former mayors were invited to the dedication of our new city hall.
n. Both the crocodile and the alligator are dangerous, but the former is more aggressive.

Meaning:
n. 1. One who protects.
2. One who legally has the care of another person.
Example:
1. This ferocious dog acts as guardian of the property at night.
2. You need the permission of your parent or guardian to go on field trips.

Meaning:
v. To lift or raise, especially by using a rope.
n. Something used to lift, as a crane or pulley.
Example:
v. The sailors hoisted the sails as we left the harbor.
n. We cannot raise this heavy machine without a hoist.

Meaning: v. To stop or seize something while it is on its way somewhere.
Example: The Coast Guard can intercept boats in United States waters to investigate their cargoes.

Meaning: n. The celebration of an anniversary, especially a fiftieth anniversary or beyond.
Example: The school marked its jubilee with a banquet for graduates from the past fifty years.

Meaning:
adj. Related by birth or marriage.
n. pl. (also kinfolk) Relatives; family.
Example:
adj. Are you kin to the Jordans, or are you just a friend of theirs?
n. She celebrated her ninetieth birthday with all her kin around her.

Meaning:
v. 1. To forgive.
2. To free from legal punishment.
n. The act of forgiving or freeing from legal punishment.
Example:
v. 1. Alice pardoned the Red Queen's rude remark.
v. 2. The president of the United States has the power to pardon those convicted of crimes.
n. The president granted a pardon to the man who showed many years of good behavior.

Meaning: v. To make known publicly; to announce.
Example: The mayor proclaimed May 18 a city holiday.

Meaning:
v. 1. To annoy or make angry.
2. To call forth; to rouse.
Example:
1. Cho said he took Katie's toys away because she provoked him with her constant talking.
2. Senator Rodriguez's comments provoked laughter in the audience.

Meaning:
v. 1. To rule as a queen or king.
2. To be widespread.
n. 1. The rule of a queen or king; the time during which a person rules.
Example:
v. 1. King Hussein of Jordan reigned for over forty years.
v. 2. Terror reigned in the streets of Paris during the French Revolution.
n. The American Revolution occurred during the reign of George III.

Meaning:
n. 1. Public disorder or violence.
2. A great and seemingly disordered quantity of something.
v. To take part in a disorder.
Example:
n. 1. Good citizens did all they could to prevent riots after the local team lost in the playoffs.
n. 2. My dad's rose garden is a riot of color in the summer.
v. As the crowd of townspeople rioted, leaders tried to calm the situation.
